predecessors.name: Principality of Chernigov
predecessors.text: the Seversk land round Novgorod-Seversk, originally a subdivision of Chernigov, with territories formerly part of Chernigov and Pereyaslavl (page, paraphrased)

successors.name: Grand Principality of Moscow
successors.text: the Seversk land round Novgorod-Seversk, originally a subdivision of Chernigov, with territories formerly part of Chernigov and Pereyaslavl (page, paraphrased)

ledger.x: 1097: Novgorod-Seversk becomes a principality of the Chernigov dynasty.

wars.name: Muscovite-Lithuanian Wars (1500-1503)
wars.outcome: Hostilities renewed in May 1500; Lithuania was beaten at Vedrosha on 14 July 1500 and the truce of 25 March 1503 left Moscow Chernigov, Novgorod-Seversk, Starodub and the upper Oka.

wars.name: Igor Svyatoslavich's campaign against the Cumans (1185)
wars.outcome: 'Ended in defeat for Prince Igor of Novgorod-Seversk', recorded in The Tale of Igor's Campaign; no change of border.

certainty.note: No boundary or town list on the page; a radius round the capital.
